text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's the first day of summer camp.
It's a
period of intense training wherein
racers can
improve their skills!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Or so it should be, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Watermelon splitting, flowing noodles,
and
barbeque parties with summer
veggies, oh my! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
There are so many fun and buono things
to do
during summer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Yeah, I remember. I've got the
Sprinters S.
waiting for me, after all!
choice_data_list: ...We came here to train, you know?
...We came here to train, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Training is my number one priority. I'm
going to
do my very, very best!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Bono! We got permission to do
watermelon
splitting on the beach! ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And Biko got a wooden sword for us to
use! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yay, thank you! And I brought a whole
bunch of
sweet watermelons for us!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I, um... So, we actually planned this out
a while
back...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So is it okay if I go?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After making one last promise to work
hard
during practice, Hishi Akebono
runs off to meet
with her friends at the
beach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At any rate... my red-hot summer camp

experience with Hishi Akebono is off to
a start!
